name: clock-helper-write
prompt: Extend clock_test.go so its fake-clock table helper can be reused by another test file. Add a helper newClockStore(ttl time.Duration) (*Store, func(time.Duration)) to clock_test.go that returns a store whose clock is frozen at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z plus a function that advances that clock, and change runClockTable to build each case's store through newClockStore. Keep runClockTable's name and signature and the clockCase field names unchanged, and keep the existing tests passing.
